The timing chain guide is a part of a spark-ignition internal combustion piston engine (the NU engine is a Hyundai/Kia gasoline engine), so heading 8409 applies. Subheading 8409.91 covers parts suitable for use solely or principally with spark-ignition engines. The 10-digit statistical line is 8409.91.9990, "Other" parts for spark-ignition engines. I recall CBP rulings on timing chain guides and tensioners classifying them under 8409.91.9990, but I did not check this against the current schedule. Part 24430-2J000 is a Hyundai/Kia part number, which fits.
